projects.name: Doornhoek Solar PV
projects.status_note: Moved from construction to online 18 Aug 2026. Commissioned 22 May 2026 per Engineering News; first BW6 project to reach COD.

projects.name: BW5 wind, Eastern Cape (1 project)
projects.note: Named project not identified in the quarterly report.

unallocated.note: Capacity with no published provincial split. Held here rather than apportioned by guesswork; a wrong split is worse than an absent one. The UI reads by_region only, so this capacity is not currently drawn on the map.

items.name: BW6, sixth project
items.note: BW6 pre-CC is 640 MW across 4 projects (p.27); 500 MW is named above, leaving 140 MW unidentified.

items.name: BW7 solar PV
items.note: 8 preferred bidders (1760 MW) appointed 23 Dec 2024, 6 (1290 MW) on 21 Jul 2025 after wind-to-solar technology reallocation, 4 (890 MW) on 15 Dec 2025 after value-for-money negotiations. Provincial figures circulated for the first tranche come from a ministerial press release, not the quarterly report, and are DELIBERATELY not apportioned to regions here: those same figures (Mpumalanga 480, Limpopo 400, Free State 480, North West 400) previously leaked into the operational capacity file and caused the geography bug this rebuild exists to fix.

items.name: RMIPPPP in construction
items.note: Report p.29 gives Northern Cape, Eastern Cape and Western Cape as the RMIPPPP provinces but no split. A further 19.94 MW site of a partially-operational project also remains under construction.

items.name: BESIPPPP BW2
items.note: Announced 23 Dec 2024; four projects at risk of the 30 Jun 2026 commercial close deadline.

items.name: BESIPPPP BW3
items.note: Five preferred bidders announced 30 May 2025; commercial close long stop 30 Oct 2026.

terminated.note: Awarded capacity that never reached commercial close. NOT part of the reconciliation identity: the IPP Office 'Capacity Procured' figure already excludes these projects.

items.name: BW5 cancelled capacity
items.note: BW5 originally awarded 2583 MW; 1424 MW (55%) was cancelled when projects failed to reach commercial close (report p.16). Provincial split not published.

meta.description: REIPPPP / RMIPPPP / BESIPPPP pipeline (preferred bidder through construction) by GridTwin ZA nodal region. Operational projects live in regional_renewable_capacity.json and are excluded here.
meta.source: IPP Office, IPPPP Quarterly Report Q4 2025/26 (as at 31 March 2026)
meta.as_at_note: Previous file carried as_at 2026-08-17, a future date. Replaced with the report's own reporting date.
meta.CHANGES: (1) The flat top-level `projects` array has been deleted - nothing in the UI read it, which is why it had drifted out of step with by_region. (2) BW7 is 3940 MW across 18 solar PV projects, not 1760 MW: 8 bidders on 23 Dec 2024 (1760 MW), 6 more on 21 Jul 2025 after wind-to-solar reallocation (1290 MW), 4 more on 15 Dec 2025 after value-for-money negotiations (890 MW). (3) BESIPPPP BW1 is all in CONSTRUCTION, not preferred bidder. (4) Aggregate entries 'BW5 solar portfolio', 'BW5 wind Eastern Cape' and 'BW5 wind Western Cape' are gone: BW5 is fully accounted for as 1075 MW at COD, 84 MW in construction and 1424 MW cancelled.
